recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，紅血球分布大致均勻，白血球與血小板在視野中很少；箭頭標示處為淡染、邊界模糊的紅血球樣結構與小團紅血球，可能代表血管內溶血後的紅血球「鬼影」（ghost cells），但此倍率無法確認細節。
features: Low-power field of normochromic red cells in a monolayer
Very few leukocytes and scarce platelets in the field, suggesting cytopenias
Arrows mark pale, poorly outlined red cell structures and a small red cell cluster
No obvious spherocytes, schistocytes or nucleated red cells resolvable at this magnification
Magnification too low to assess red cell morphology in detail
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows a monolayer of normochromic red cells with very few leukocytes and scarce platelets in the field, raising the possibility of cytopenias. The arrows highlight pale, poorly outlined red cell structures and a small cluster of red cells, which may represent lysed red cell ghosts reflecting intravascular hemolysis, although detail is not resolvable at this magnification. No schistocytes or spherocytes can be assessed reliably. The findings are nonspecific but compatible with an intravascular hemolytic process such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, which requires flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Shows prominent irregular red cell agglutinates throughout the smear, with a positive DAT for C3 and high-titer cold agglutinins.
Intravascular hemolysis with numerous schistocytes and severe thrombocytopenia on higher power.
Pancytopenia without hemolysis; LDH, reticulocyte count and hemosiderinuria are normal and FLAER/CD59 expression is intact.
